Beth Shaw is one of South Africa's leading equine therapists, treating over 200 horse patients a month. Her phenomenal success and highly respected work is attributed to the intensive training she has received from Winks Greene a legend and pioneer of equine physiotherapy. Beth employs the Winks Greene methods of pinpointing and treating muscular -- skeletal injuries of the equine athlete.
 
Beth has been encouraged and endorsed by Winks Greene to offer an intensive training course to select students at the BSET Academy, operating out of the Natal Equine Rehabilitation Centre. Our goal at BSET is to produce top class horse therapists who specialize in Equine Faradic Therapy.
